page_title: ATA 2-1 ROM | Atalanta v AS Roma 12/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Matias Soule (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+5' A cross from Angelino (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
90+5' Simone Sozza blows the whistle, Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
90+3' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) commits a foul and Simone Sozza immediately signals a free kick.
90+1' Matias Soule (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

90+1' Angelino (AS Roma) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Simone Sozza shows the yellow card to Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
88' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Mateo Retegui will be replaced by Daniel Maldini (Atalanta).
88' It is time for a substitution. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is on for Ademola Lookman.
87' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
86' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Artem Dovbyk is replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma).
85' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) has come on for Manu Kone.
85' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Eldor Shomurodov.
82' Here's the change. Raoul Bellanova leaves the pitch and Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
82' Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempts to convert the resulting set piece, but his miskick only goes way over the crossbar. A poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
81' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) brings his opponent down. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma earn a free kick.
81' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
80' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
76' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) replacing Devyne Rensch.
76' 2 - 1 Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) gets to the rebound and from long range fires the ball into the back of the net.

75' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
74' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
73' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simone Sozza no option but to blow his whistle.

70' What a chance that is! Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
70' Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

69' Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Charles De Ketelaere.
68' Here is a change. Mario Pasalic is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta).
65' NO PENALTY! Referee Simone Sozza has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The AS Roma players are incensed.
64' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for AS Roma as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

63' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to AS Roma!
61' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

59' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
58' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
56' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
56' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

55' Matias Soule (AS Roma) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
54' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) tested Marco Carnesecchi with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.

53' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
52' A dangerous looking corner kick from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is cleared to safety by the defence.
49' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
48' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

47' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
47' The resulting corner from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is cleared.

46' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
45+2' The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
45+2' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.
45+1' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Manu Kone.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Matias Soule (AS Roma) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
43' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to AS Roma in a dangerous position.
42' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
42' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
41' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Manu Kone (AS Roma) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
40' AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

40' Angelino (AS Roma) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
39' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. AS Roma have a free kick.

37' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
36' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
34' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
32' 1 - 1 Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) reacts well to a deflected cross from Matias Soule and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the left of the goal. 1:1.
31' AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Angelino (AS Roma). AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
27' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
24' What a wasted opportunity by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Mile Svilar makes a decent save to thwart him.
22' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
22' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
21' Dangerous play by Angelino (AS Roma). Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.

19' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
19' Matias Soule (AS Roma) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
18' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Simone Sozza interrupted the game to signal a free kick. That's a free kick to AS Roma.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
18' Manu Kone (AS Roma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Simone Sozza had a clear view and blows his whistle.
16' Matias Soule (AS Roma) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

16' Matias Soule (AS Roma) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

15' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Simone Sozza blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

11' What a chance that is! Marten de Roon (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere shows great vision to find Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
8' Angelino (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.

8' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Marco Carnesecchi has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
7' The resulting corner from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is cleared by the defence.
6' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
5' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
4' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Angelino (AS Roma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
2' Matias Soule (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
